# v2 semantic tokens

Every `--v2-*` token defined in `src/styles/tokens/theme.css`, grouped by role.

- **Light** comes from `:root` merged with `[data-color-scheme="light"]`. **Dark** comes from `:root` merged with `[data-color-scheme="dark"]`.
- Values are the default OC-2 theme. A resolved OC-2 primitive hex follows `→`. Other themes compute the values at runtime (`src/theme/v2/resolve.ts`), so never copy a hex value into component code.
- **Tailwind** is `yes` when `src/styles/tailwind/colors.css` maps the token, for example `bg-v2-background-bg-base` or `text-v2-text-text-muted`.
